title: Doomsday primer: same actor, different announced character
question: Does Robert Downey Jr. returning establish that Doctor Doom is an evil Tony Stark?

sources.title: Disney+ official Doomsday guide, published 30 September 2026
sources.excerpt: There’s no confirmed connection between Tony Stark and Doctor Doom; monarch of Latveria; master of both sorcery and technology Paraphrased context: Prior viewing is optional; First Steps introduced this version of the Fantastic Four to the MCU.

sources.title: Disney: Downey and Russo return announcement, 27 July 2024
sources.excerpt: the return of Disney Legend Robert Downey Jr. in a new role as Doctor Doom

sources.title: Disney current US Doomsday movie page

claims.text: The official Disney+ guide says a Tony Stark–Doctor Doom connection has not been confirmed; the script must not call that connection impossible.
Robert Downey Jr., previously Tony Stark/Iron Man, returns in a new announced role as Doctor Doom.
The current Disney US title page lists a theatrical release on 18 December 2026; this is not an India release-date verification.
The Disney+ guide describes Victor von Doom as Latveria’s monarch and a practitioner of both sorcery and technology.
The guide connects Doom’s history to the Fantastic Four and compares his intellect with Reed Richards.
The official guide identifies The Fantastic Four: First Steps as the film that introduced this Fantastic Four team to the MCU, and says prior viewing is not required for Doomsday.

notes: Primary-source reporting plus clearly signalled interpretation. Checked 6 November 2026 IST (5 November UTC). The casting announcement is historical context, not fresh breaking news. No future plot or film-comic equivalence is asserted. Official UK date sources conflict; pilot avoids UK and India release claims. No images/footage/music rights supplied.
